What it is: After the statusline block and before the final console.log: mkdir -p ~/.claude/agents/ then loop over general-plugin/agents/*.md copying each file to ~/.claude/agents/
Why interesting: Enables named agent files so skills reference them by subagent_type instead of embedding instructions inline

What it is: Research agent. Tool priority: (1) Context7 MCP — mcp__context7__resolve-library-id then mcp__context7__query-docs / (2) WebFetch on official docs / (3) WebSearch with cross-verification. Provenance tag every factual claim: [VERIFIED] = confirmed via Context7 or official docs this session / [CITED: url] = linked source / [ASSUMED] = training knowledge only. Package check for every recommended package: run npm view <pkg> version (Node) or pip index versions <pkg> (Python) — if command errors the package is likely hallucinated / remove it. Writes .plan/RESEARCH.md with sections: Standard Stack (table: library / version / purpose / provenance tag) / Architecture Pattern / Don't Hand-Roll (table: problem / use instead / why) / Common Pitfalls / Package Legitimacy (table: package / registry check / result) / Environment (table: tool / required for / available) / Open Questions (for vibe:plan to resolve). Content embedded inline in agent file — no GSD dependency.
Why interesting: Catches hallucinated libraries before they land in tasks; provenance discipline makes research trustworthy

What it is: Adversarial reviewer. Bug pattern checklist embedded inline in agent file (covers: null/undefined access / off-by-one / async/timing / state management / import/module / type coercion / environment/config / data shape / error handling / scope/closure). Stance: assume defects exist — starting hypothesis is this code has bugs. Input via prompt: depth (quick/standard/deep) and file list. quick = grep only — secrets / dangerous sinks / debug artifacts / empty catch. standard = read each file + language checks — JS/TS / Python / Go / Shell. deep = all of standard + cross-file: import graph / call chains / error propagation / type consistency at API boundaries. Output: markdown to terminal grouped BLOCKER → WARNING → INFO / each finding has file:line / description / fix suggestion. Second pass applies checklist.md from vibe:review skill.
Why interesting: Single agent at any depth; adversarial stance + systematic bug pattern checklist replaces vibes-based review

What it is: Replaces and deletes general-plugin/skills/audit/SKILL.md; checklist.md moved from audit/ to review/. Get file list: git diff --cached --name-only first / fallback to git diff HEAD --name-only. Filter out: lock files (package-lock.json / yarn.lock / *.lock) / generated (dist/ / build/ / *.min.js) / .plan/ directory. If no files remain print 'Nothing to review.' and stop. Parse depth flag: --quick / --standard / no flag = deep (default). Read general-plugin/skills/review/checklist.md then spawn code-reviewer agent with depth + file list + checklist content. Agent produces two blocks: adversarial findings + checklist pass. All output to terminal only / no file written. If review clean: suggest commit message.
Why interesting: One skill replaces two; deep by default; checklist always runs as a second pass inside the agent

What it is: Two additions to conversation_flow: (1) In Stage 1 PROBE: check if .plan/RESEARCH.md exists — read silently if found. In Stage 2 OPEN (before existing plan check): if RESEARCH.md absent ask once via AskUserQuestion 'Run researcher agent before planning?' — yes spawns researcher subagent (subagent_type: researcher) with git probe + $ARGUMENTS as context then reads RESEARCH.md / no skips. (2) In Stage 3 FOLLOW THE THREAD: when plan hits a genuine gray area add guideline — produce 5-column table before recommending: Option / Pros / Cons / Complexity / Recommendation — Recommendation must always be conditional ('Rec if X') never a single winner.
Why interesting: Research folded into plan flow; comparison tables prevent dogmatic single-winner recommendations

What it is: Add detection block at start of Step 3 (Synthesize the Note) before the template branch. AI framework triggers: explicit names (LangChain / LlamaIndex / LangGraph / CrewAI / AutoGen / Haystack / OpenAI Agents SDK / Anthropic SDK / Google ADK / Vercel AI SDK / DSPy / Instructor / LiteLLM) or any package whose README prominently mentions LLM / agent / RAG / embedding pipeline / tool use / structured output. When detected: write standard template sections first / then append four extra sections: ## Core Pattern (minimal runnable snippet for the primary system type from fetched docs — mark [ASSUMED] if not in docs) / ## Structured Output (how this framework integrates Pydantic or equivalent — include the framework-specific method e.g. .with_structured_output() / instructor / PydanticOutputParser) / ## Async Notes (the single most common async mistake for this framework in 2-3 sentences) / ## Context Window Strategy (how the framework handles context exceeding the model window — one paragraph).
Why interesting: Richer AI framework notes without replacing the standard template

What it is: Content embedded inline in general-plugin/agents/code-reviewer.md (bug pattern checklist covering: null/undefined / off-by-one / async/timing / state management / import/module / type coercion / environment/config / data shape / error handling / scope). No file copy or GSD path reference — self-contained in the agent.
Why interesting: Systematic scan list gives the reviewer a starting checklist covering ~80% of frequent bugs; no GSD dependency

What it is: Two models added inline to vibe:work Stage 4 DISPATCH IMPLEMENTERS implementer prompt — Circle of Concern vs Control: before modifying any file not in the task Files list ask whether it is in scope — if not document as deviation note / do NOT fix it / and Forcing Function: resolve hard decisions at build time not at runtime using TypeScript never types / build-time assertions / interfaces that force error handling. No file reference needed.
Why interesting: Directly counters the #1 executor failure: scope creep from while-I'm-here fixes that TDD mandate does not address

What it is: Relevant general rules embedded inline in each agent file (researcher / code-reviewer / debugger): do not read agent definition files directly / do not inline large files into subagent prompts / do not re-derive context unnecessarily / warn when context is heavy. GSD-specific rules (gsd-sdk / iOS / STATE.md) omitted — not relevant to this setup.
Why interesting: Prevents agent context bloat as the agent library grows

What it is: 4-level verification check added inline to vibe:work Stage 5 reviewer instructions as step 6 — reviewer must check for each file in task Files: (1) Exists: file present at expected path / (2) Substantive: real implementation not stub or placeholder (grep for TODO/FIXME/placeholder/not implemented/return null) / (3) Wired: connected to the rest of the system (imported / registered / called) / (4) Functional: actually works when invoked (covered by re-running Done-when commands). Levels 1-3 checked programmatically. Level 4 via Done-when commands already in step 3.
Why interesting: Reviewer currently checks Done-when commands exist; this adds wired and functional checks

What it is: Creates two files: general-plugin/agents/debugger.md + general-plugin/skills/debug/SKILL.md. Agent: philosophy and thinking models embedded inline — User=reporter/Claude=investigator / cognitive biases table / fault tree analysis / hypothesis-driven PREDICT→TEST→OBSERVE→CONCLUDE / Occam's razor (check simple causes first) / counterfactual thinking / restart protocol. Skill: collect symptom description from user (expected/actual/error/when) + recent git log / spawn debugger agent with pre-filled symptoms / present root cause + proposed fix. No GSD path references.
Why interesting: No debug skill exists; complete battle-tested pattern with clear investigator philosophy

What it is: Creates general-plugin/skills/verify/SKILL.md. Conversational UAT loop: read .plan/PLAN.md for DoD criteria / for each criterion state expected behavior and ask user if reality matches / record pass or fail in .plan/UAT.md / resume from last checkpoint if UAT.md exists. When all features tested: summarize PASS/FAIL/SKIPPED counts. If failures found: suggest re-run vibe:work for failed items or investigate with vibe:debug. Clean state: print 'All criteria verified. Ready to ship.'
Why interesting: Closes the vibe:work loop — work currently ends at tasks done with no feature validation step

What it is: Creates general-plugin/skills/add-tests/SKILL.md. Get changed files via git diff HEAD --name-only (fallback to git diff main...HEAD). Classify each file: TDD (unit test — business logic / transformations / validators / parsers / state machines) / E2E (browser test — keyboard shortcuts / navigation / forms / selection / drag-drop / modals / data grids) / Skip (config / migrations / CSS / trivial CRUD / type defs). Present classification to user for approval before generating. Generate tests following RED-GREEN: RED must fail before implementing / if test passes immediately it tests the wrong thing / if existing code fails a test flag it as bug — do NOT fix. README updated to clarify this skill is for retrofit/E2E — plan→tasks→work pipeline handles TDD inline.
Why interesting: Fills the gap when TDD was bypassed; README distinction prevents it being used as a TDD replacement

What it is: Updated general-plugin/skills/work/SKILL.md Stage 6. After all DoD criteria pass and ALL TASKS COMPLETE promise is output: add one optional prompt 'Extract learnings from this session? (y/n)'. If yes: read .plan/PLAN.md and .plan/TASKS.md / extract into .plan/LEARNINGS.md with 4 sections: Decisions (choices made and why with task source reference) / Lessons (what would be done differently) / Patterns (reusable approaches discovered) / Surprises (unexpected findings each with source task reference). Only extract what is explicitly documented in artifacts — do not fabricate.
Why interesting: Captures institutional memory at the natural end of a work session without requiring a separate command
Effort: Low — add after DoD check in Stage 6

What it is: Creates general-plugin/skills/ship/SKILL.md. No new branch creation — works on current branch. Three steps: (1) Preflight: check git remote and gh CLI availability / check if .plan/ transient files (PLAN.md/TASKS.md/SUMMARY.md/CONTEXT.md/RESEARCH.md/UAT.md) are tracked — if yes warn user and offer to git rm --cached + .gitignore them + commit removal / LEARNINGS.md and ROADMAP.md preserved. (2) Generate PR body: read .plan/PLAN.md for goal and scope / produce title (under 70 chars) and body (summary bullets + test plan checklist from DoD). (3) Push current branch and run gh pr create --draft with generated title and body.
Why interesting: Automates draft PR creation with planning context; warns about .plan/ transient noise in PR diff
